news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Explain Controversial Dialogue in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela addressed criticism surrounding a specific line in their recent film, The Paradise. The director clarified that the controversial dialogue was intended to be ironic, but the scene lost its intended impact because necessary backstory was edited out to reduce runtime. Meanwhile, the movie is steadily moving toward the Rs. 150 crore gross milestone by the conclusion of its opening weekend.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Embraces Vintage Aesthetic in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu showcased a striking retro look in her newest photoshoot, featuring voluminous curls and a vintage-themed backdrop. Despite experiencing a challenging box office run in 2026 with underperforming titles, she remains busy with her upcoming project Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu to Maintain Planned Sankranti Release
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming mass action entertainer Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed that the film will stick to its scheduled release date of January 12, 2027. Despite potential box office clashes during the Sankranti season, producer Chaitanya Reddy stated that post-production is nearing completion and the team has no intention of altering their plans.

news.title: Hombale Films Acquires Southern Rights for Hit Hindi Film Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Following its massive box office success in the Hindi belt, the low-budget drama Hanuman Ansh is expanding its reach into southern languages. Hombale Films has secured the regional dubbing rights to distribute the movie across the south. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, the narrative chronicles the early life of Lakshmi Narayan and his eventual transformation into Neem Karoli Baba.

news.title: NTR Gear Up to Restart Dragon Production in Mumbai
news.summary: Following a temporary break due to a shoulder injury, star actor NTR is set to return to the sets of his upcoming film Dragon. Director Prashanth Neel has kept production moving by shooting sequences that do not feature the lead actor. A major two-week action schedule is planned to kick off in Mumbai on October 10th.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion of January 12 Vidudala Shoot
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is racing through the final production stages of his upcoming directorial venture, January 12 Vidudala. The cast features Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in pivotal roles. The team is gearing up for a fresh shooting schedule in Ooty next month before heading overseas for song sequences.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, has opened to unprecedented success and established itself as his biggest box-office opener. The film sustained robust ticket sales into its third day and saw massive family crowds flocking to cinemas over the weekend. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the project continues to demonstrate powerful theatrical traction.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Unique Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird was officially launched by Aakash Jagannadh in Hyderabad, setting high expectations for the romantic drama. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie stars Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in lead roles. The narrative follows a carefree young man whose life turns upside down when the woman he falls for mysteriously disappears.

news.title: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Reveals Stunning New Posters for Ranbir and Yash
news.summary: Director Nitesh Tiwari's grand mythological project Ramayana has generated massive excitement with fresh promotional materials. The newly released posters showcase Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram alongside his core cast, while also introducing Yash in a striking regal avatar as Ravana. The film's first part is slated for a Diwali 2026 theatrical release, followed by Part 2 in Diwali 2027.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has officially dropped following an unveiling event in Hyderabad. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie transitions from a youthful romance into an emotional mystery when the female lead vanishes. The film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Crushes Box Office Expectations Over Weekend
news.summary: Despite a risky mid-week premiere and initial mixed reviews from critics, Nani's latest movie The Paradise has put up a strong box office performance. The makers report a worldwide gross of 136 crores over its first three days, driven by surging collections in the Telugu states and solid overseas numbers.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Shoot for Prashanth Neel's Dragon in Mumbai
news.summary: Actor NTR is heading back to work after recovering from a recent shoulder surgery that kept him sidelined for nearly two months. He will join Anil Kapoor in Mumbai starting October 10 for a 15-day schedule featuring intense action sequences for the pan-India film Dragon. Directed by Prashanth Neel, the movie is currently eyeing a June 2027 release.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Eyes Crucial Box Office Test Following Mixed Weekend Responses
news.summary: Nani's big-budget venture The Paradise opened to massive numbers despite encountering mixed feedback from audiences and critics regarding its narrative pacing and emotional depth. Trade estimates indicate the film earned a solid opening weekend gross, bringing it closer to its target, though weekday performances remain vital. With no major theatrical competition arriving next week, the upcoming box-office hold will ultimately define its commercial outcome.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Drop for Nitesh Tiwari's Epic Ramayana Adaptation
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming two-part pan-Indian epic Ramayana have released striking new visuals featuring Yash as an imposing Ravana alongside a serene trio representing Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra and Monster Mind Creations, the ambitious project features a musical score by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The film is scheduled for consecutive Diwali releases in 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Nagarjuna’s Milestone Project King100 Prepares Special Teaser Highlighting Tabu
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's landmark film King100 is gearing up to unveil a special promotional video introducing Tabu as one of the primary female leads. The project reunites Nagarjuna and Tabu on screen years after their classic 1990s collaboration Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik and produced by Annapurna Studios and Manam Enterprises, the movie is scheduled to hit theaters on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Makers of Vijay Deverakonda Starrer Ranabaali Announce Promotional Four-Part Documentary Series
news.summary: Director Rahul Sankrityan's upcoming historical drama Ranabaali, starring Vijay Deverakonda, is set to release a four-part companion documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. Stemming from two years of historical research into Rayalaseema under British rule, the promotional series will feature insights from the lead actors and director. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the feature film is slated for an October 16, 2026 theatrical release.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela After Catching The Paradise
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR recently caught a screening of Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the entire team, highlighting how the film powerfully captures Telangana's distinct cultural identity and the struggles of an oppressed community. Several political figures accompanied him to the special screening.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Higher Digital Valuations for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Reports indicate that digital platforms are offering higher valuations for female-centric projects led by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Industry insiders attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters and her vast social media footprint. Meanwhile, Sai Pallavi maintains a strong reputation for her selective roles and performance-driven filmography.

news.title: The Paradise Sustains BookMyShow Momentum Despite Mixed Early Talk
news.summary: Nani's action entertainer The Paradise has held its ground on ticketing platforms, registering 252K ticket sales on BookMyShow during its third day. Despite facing polarised reactions, the big-budget project crossed Rs. 115 crore in gross over its first two days. Fans and makers are closely watching how the film performs through the remainder of its opening week.

news.title: Shocking Exit in Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10
news.summary: Wildcard entrant Mithilesh surprised viewers by exiting the Bigg Boss Telugu 10 house just 24 hours after his arrival. He chose to accept a ₹15 lakh cash offer, explaining that he felt winning the title was no longer possible due to house dynamics.

news.title: Nani Praises Cast and Crew at The Paradise Meet
news.summary: Actor Nani spoke at a media event in Hyderabad for his movie The Paradise, praising the relentless hard work of the entire technical team and cast. He highlighted that the film has resonated strongly with audiences and described it as a long-term box office contender.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise His Deadliest Yet
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu shared his experience working on The Paradise, stating that his character is the most intense of his 50-year career. He also lauded director Srikanth Odela's vision and actor Nani's dedication during a recent press meet in Hyderabad.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Paradise's Unique Box Office Turnaround
news.summary: During a press interaction, actor Nani noted the unusual trajectory of The Paradise, where audience reception shifted remarkably from negative to positive with each passing show. The Srikanth Odela directorial features a prominent ensemble cast including Mohan Babu and is backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri.

news.title: Fresh Posters of Ramayana Showcase Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash
news.summary: Fresh promotional posters for the mythological spectacle Ramayana have debuted, highlighting the divine appearance of the lead cast alongside Yash as Ravana. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by producer Namit Malhotra, the grand project features visual effects by DNEG and is slated for a worldwide IMAX release in Diwali 2026.
